intraday_profile.reason: UNG is unsuitable for intraday trading due to insufficient 1-min volatility and inherent noise. Daily ATR (3.04%) implies 1-min ATR ≈ 0.0021% (3.04% / 1440 minutes), which is far below the 0.05% threshold required to clear spreads/slippage. Trading literature explicitly states UNG has 'moderate liquidity, wider spreads, noisy 1-min bars' (Peng Liu, Iris Mack). The asset-class catalyst (EIA Natural Gas Storage Report at 10:30 AM ET) further compounds volatility risk, but the core liquidity issue overrides all other factors. Daily direction (SHORT) is irrelevant since the asset cannot be traded intraday profitably.
catalyst_times: EIA Natural Gas Storage Report: 10:30 AM ET (avoid trading 10:15-10:45 AM ET)
